input.subject: VIP Broker Preview — new Tribeca condominium (renderings attached)
input.bodyText:
Brokers,

You're invited to a private VIP preview of a new Tribeca condominium ahead of its public sales launch. Full details, renderings, and anticipated pricing are in the attached brochure. Nothing is on sale yet — this is an advance look for our top brokers.

RSVP for the preview event.

Grace Lin
SERHANT. New Development

attachments.parsedText:
THE FRANKLIN — 108 Franklin St, Tribeca
A new 42-residence boutique condominium by Studio Renderings.

Sales launch: anticipated Q4 2026. Not yet on the market.

Anticipated pricing (subject to offering plan):
- 2BR homes anticipated from ~$2.9M
- 3BR homes anticipated from ~$4.4M
- Penthouse duplex anticipated ~$11M

Amenities: attended lobby, fitness suite, children's playroom, private storage. Estimated first closings 2027. Register interest for a priority preview appointment.
